    """Encode runs of the same character using character + run length.

    Lengths of 1 are omitted: encode('aaabcc') == 'a3bc2'.

def decode(s):
    """Decode an RLE string produced by encode.

    Run lengths may have more than one digit.
    """

    i = 0

        ch = s[i]
